title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer
locations: Boston, MA; Brooklyn, NY; San Francisco, CA; Washington, D.C.
description:
Altana is the network for trusted trade. Our AI-powered product network empowers governments and businesses to build a more resilient and secure global economy while keeping trade flowing.
 The Opportunity at Altana
 We're looking for a Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer to lead the AI behind Altana Nexus, our agentic platform for global trade. You'll work on a continuous stream of public and proprietary trade data (shipments, customs filings, trade documents), and build the models and AI agents that turn it into real-time decisions on risk, compliance and enforcement for governments and the world's largest companies.
  
 Your Responsibilities 
 Drive the technical direction for agentic systems. Define the architecture and roadmap for the models and agentic systems that process trade data as it arrives (shipments, customs declarations, invoices, bills of lading) and turn it into risk, classification and compliance decisions in real time.
 Build the pipeline from ingestion to decision. Lead the design of reliable, cost-efficient systems for ingestion, document understanding, entity resolution, inference and routing across models, at the scale of global trade.
 Adapt models to trade. Use analyst feedback, production outcomes and agent traces to fine-tune and post-train models (SFT, DPO, RL with domain graders) where it measurably beats prompting, and keep every model improving over time.
 Design the observability and feedback stack. Build the evals, tracing and feedback loops that decide what ships and catch regressions in production.
 Lead beyond your team. Mentor senior engineers, raise the technical bar across Engineering, and help shape how we hire and level ML talent.
 Shape the product and the business. Work with software engineers, data scientists, product managers and customers to generate new business ideas and turn ambiguous problems into shipped capabilities.
 About You
 BS/MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent experience
 10+ years building and shipping ML systems in production, with a proven track record of delivering product-oriented ML solutions, including recent work on LLM-powered products
 Deep expertise in PyTorch and the modern Python ML stack (Hugging Face, scikit-learn, NumPy, Pandas/Polars)
 Hands-on experience building production LLM applications: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool/function calling, structured outputs, and agentic workflows
 You've shipped agentic systems in production and know their failure modes: tool use, planning, state, recovery and human-in-the-loop
 Experience post-training or adapting LLMs (SFT, DPO, RLHF/RLAIF, reward modeling) for a production use case
 Rigorous about evaluation: you've built eval suites, golden datasets and LLM-as-judge pipelines
 Sound judgment on when to use a frontier model API, a fine-tuned open-weight model, or a classical ML model, balancing cost, latency, and accuracy
 Senior Staff-level technical leadership: you set architecture direction across teams, mentor engineers, and turn ambiguous problems into roadmaps
 Passionate about applying SOTA techniques to real-world problems, with a willingness to get your hands dirty in the data and domain to achieve measurable outcomes
 You care deeply about engineering excellence, supportability and knowledge-sharing
 You have strong written and verbal communication skills
 Heavy user of AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) in your daily workflow

title: Senior Applied Data Scientist
description:
ABOUT CLAIR

If you can send your friends money in seconds, why does it still take your employer two weeks to send your paycheck?

At Clair, we are on a mission to create financial freedom for America's workers by giving them a digital banking platform that allows them to get paid as soon as they clock out of work. But we're not just another digital bank or on-demand pay provider. We meet Americans at their place of work by embedding our products within the scheduling, workforce management, and payroll apps they already use every day.

Learn more about us at getclair.com/about http://getclair.com/about




ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Applied Data Scientist on Clair’s Data Science team, you’ll be responsible for developing and maintaining the next generation of credit models and predictive systems that power Clair’s financial products. You’ll shape how millions of hourly workers access affordable credit, leveraging cutting-edge data science to assess risk, predict repayment, and optimize credit decisions.

We’re looking for someone who thrives at the intersection of data science, machine learning, and fintech, and who’s excited to translate messy, real-world data into clear, actionable intelligence. This role blends credit modeling with feature engineering — from designing new model features (including predictive features) based on user transaction data to deploying and monitoring production-ready ML models that drive critical product decisions.

To succeed, you’ll need a deep technical foundation in machine learning and statistical modeling, hands-on experience in model deployment, and strong communication skills to collaborate with engineers, product managers, and risk teams.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Develop and maintain credit risk and repayment models that directly power Clair’s underwriting and decision systems.

 - Design and engineer predictive features using transaction-level data, including the prediction of user income flows, spending, and repayment behaviors.

 - Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy, monitor, and optimize models in production environments using AWS and Snowflake ML Platform.

 - Build prototypes of new modeling methodologies and present them to stakeholders for evaluation and feedback.

 - Investigate and analyze credit performance, identifying root causes of model drift or unexpected repayment behavior.

 - Partner cross-functionally with product, risk, and engineering teams to turn data insights into product improvements and credit strategy refinements.

 - Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Stay current on best practices and emerging techniques in credit modeling, explainable AI, and financial ML systems.




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years of professional experience in data science and machine learning.

 - Proven track record of leading end-to-end data science projects — from research and model development to deployment and monitoring.

 - Experience building and productionizing credit or risk assessment models.

 - Strong proficiency in Python and familiarity with modern ML libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, XGBoost, etc.).

 - Strong command of SQL and experience working with large transactional and time-series datasets.

 - Strong communication skills and ability to translate complex findings into actionable insights.

 - Experience working with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced production environment.
